what: Seven training-free paper targets across three backbones, to test whether ANY frame span reproduces the paper's ScanNet++ numbers
code_patch: none -- ran clean, the device fix from ticket 9 is committed upstream

runs.pass2: --pairs 300, vggt + pi3 only -- the ticket's prescribed remedy for the R^2 gate

verdict_vanilla: AGREE at stride 60, fit-free, on two independent backbones. VGGT 7.242 vs paper 7.21 (off 0.032); pi3 6.392 vs paper 6.17 (off 0.222). Fitted I* agrees independently: 44.30 (VGGT) and 43.19 (pi3) bracket stride 60's measured I=43.706.
verdict_pinhole_methods: DISAGREE at every swept span, fit-free, on all three backbones. All five ratio cross-checks miss: VGGT vanilla/center_ph wants 2.94 (ours 4.00-14.26), pi3 wants 2.71 (ours 9.17-36.94), DA3 wants 3.12/6.15/1.97 (ours ~1.2-1.6/~1.0-1.6/~0.8-1.3).
r2_gate: Center-PH R^2 stayed below the 0.90 gate at BOTH 100 and 300 pairs (VGGT 0.856->0.874, pi3 0.658->0.652 -- pi3's got worse). More pairs cannot clear it: the fit is loose because Center-PH's R is nearly span-independent, so there is almost no variance for the line to explain. Structural, not noise. Per the ticket's guard rail NO I*-based verdict is claimed for Center-PH. The ratio block is fit-free and unaffected.
anomaly_center_ph: Our Center-PH numbers look non-physical and reproduce EXACTLY across the two independent passes. pi3 Center-PH: R=0.048 deg at stride 1 rising only to 0.206 deg at stride 80, t=1.24 deg, skill 278x. The angular error stays ~0.2 deg while the true rotation it must estimate grows from 0.84 to 57.2 deg. A real estimator's error grows with the rotation being estimated. Flagged as measured, not diagnosed -- but every single disagreement above involves a pinhole-rectified method, so this path should be checked for leakage before concluding the paper is wrong.
note_da3_i_star: No verdict on DA3's I* by the script's own design (Tab. 1 is a mean over unnamed scenes).
